items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: So Lenny say, 'Hot dog, what you know? I'm going to call Willie and tell Willie we have found Sippie.' ... So he used my telephone and Willie wasn't there at first. ... Lenny say, 'Willie, I have found Sippie Wallace.'

ctx.x: Vicki (unintelligible). She cussed, but she cussed different than Bessie Smith. Bessie Smith (unintelligible), but Vicki (unintelligible). I used to tell Vicki all the time, 'Now, I wish you would come to my home.' I say, 'Vicki, don't cuss so much.' And she used to cuss Lenny so much. I say, '--
